caveats: 35 reasoning rows across three families and three repetitions plan 3675 slots; retained counts describe only the projected evidence.
OMP and Muse use 120-second trial budgets; Devin uses 300 seconds. Different routes and budgets prevent model-only causal comparisons.

Recorded source commits and snapshot hashes identify base commits or working-tree snapshots; they are not, by themselves, proof of clean checkouts. Structured provenance retains the exact source identities and hashes.
VM routes use the September 14 dirty extracted snapshot, frozen-lockfile dependencies and prebuilt dist from the archive. Source hashes do not imply identical compiled binaries.

Muse scoring is quota-limited. Complete dispatch does not mean complete grading. Sequential cases produce different graded case mixes across reasoning levels; graded-only pass percentages must not be ranked or treated as comparable. Quota scope is not established; the diagnostic receipt remains private.
Live read-only account data can change across sequential, non-randomized rows. Only the two fixed-table cases are serialized across hosts.
OMP effort evidence is runtime configuration, Muse is adapter argv only, and Devin is the exact ATIF model UID when present. No route attests provider-applied reasoning.

Provider and native execution failures are separated post-run from graded conformance failures. Per-row and per-family metadata retain raw and corrected counts plus the classifier and private receipt hashes; raw evidence is unchanged, with no answer regrading or outcome-selective reruns.
Planned, dispatched, graded, passed, failed and unscored are separate counts. Runtime failures are unscored, not correctness failures.
Grades measure tool-use conformance, not answer correctness. Provider text and tool payloads are withheld for privacy_review.

Invalid predecessor cohorts were excluded in full, not selected by outcome, and do not enter the 3675-slot denominator. Their retained terminal counts and inventory are recorded in reproduction provenance.
methodology.grading: Numeric deterministic conformance scores; details withheld for privacy_review
methodology.harness: OMP, native Muse and native Devin

publicProjection.numericEvidencePolicy: Counts, numeric scores, timing, result-byte metrics and attestation values come from private row summaries without regrading. Token totals aggregate only trials with recorded usage; missing usage and empty token populations remain null, never fabricated zeros. Devin family identity is normalized for grouping while the exact native model UID is retained.
publicProjection.sourceEvidenceScope: Private row directories (summary, manifests, per-trial terminal, observation, transcript and native session files, quarantined aborted slots) stay outside the repository; verification.json carries their digests and recomputed counts only.
